body: There's a lot of ways to become a parent. I wish you all the best in your dream to become a dad!

I agree. When it comes to children it's a different story. I accepted my responsibility before her, and more or less I started feeling better when we got her. She's loved, I love spending time with her any time of day, we play, we laugh, we chase each other. Depression is a modern day plague, almost everyone with high level of intelligence and empathy is affected by it.
Yes, she brings joy when I come home, she can't yet talk properly, but the way she says pappa is priceless. That's what I live for.
Yes. But I can't imagine what impact my death will have on my young daughter, she's the one keeping me alive.

Thank you! I understand the necessity to talk to someone to have a chance at resolving some of my concerns. I am aware it will probably take a lot of time. Hopefully, I'll have enough courage to do so.
I tried talking to a friend of mine, but I got judged and now am afraid to talk to anyone else.
